title: Buy low, sell high

timeline.text: Opening bell! Clear skies over the court. Prices are calm for now.
Watch the ticker - a player is heating up.

timeline.headline: SGA heating up: three straight 35-point nights

timeline.text: Forecast: sunshine for SGA. Buyers are piling in.
Hot streaks cool down. A profit only counts once you sell.
The hype is drifting off. Ten seconds to the closing bell!

goal.text: Buy SGA, then sell it for a profit before the bell.

lesson: You only make money when you sell for more than you paid - and hype doesn't last forever.
